entries.text: 冗余索引与重复索引检查区分开，使用不同预警级别 RuleDuplicateIndexDisallowed
entries.textEn: Redundant and duplicate index checks are separated, with distinct severities for RuleDuplicateIndexDisallowed

entries.text: 阈值解析提升健壮性；阈值为空时使用默认阈值
entries.textEn: More robust threshold parsing; an empty threshold falls back to the default

entries.text: 修复在线获取无符号整型列类型的缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed retrieving unsigned integer column types online

entries.text: 修复缺少分号结尾的 SQL 在脚本解析时出错的问题
entries.textEn: Fixed script parsing failing on SQL without a trailing semicolon

entries.text: 新增 SQL Server 的 convert 函数支持
entries.textEn: Added SQL Server convert function support

entries.text: 支持对象类型的变量引用（如 :customer.name）
entries.textEn: Added object-typed variable references such as :customer.name

entries.text: 支持带后缀的数字常量（1000L、1.0d、2.0f）
entries.textEn: Added numeric literals with suffixes (1000L, 1.0d, 2.0f)

entries.text: 新增 replace 语法支持
entries.textEn: Added replace syntax

entries.text: 修复多表更新列与占位符的序列化缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed serialisation of multi-table update columns and placeholders

entries.text: 修复脚本解析时的表对象上下文更新与分区类型判断
entries.textEn: Fixed table-object context updates and partition-type detection in script parsing

entries.text: 为更新目标列添加表信息
entries.textEn: Update target columns now carry table information

entries.text: 脚本解析支持游标变量引用（PL/SQL）
entries.textEn: Script parsing supports cursor variable references (PL/SQL)

entries.text: 修复 PL/SQL 语法文件缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed a defect in the PL/SQL grammar file

entries.text: 把 for 循环与代码块声明的参数纳入上下文，避免被误认为表的列
entries.textEn: Parameters declared in for loops and blocks stay in context so they are not mistaken for table columns

entries.text: 列新增是否压缩与压缩算法属性；支持分区列表信息
entries.textEn: Columns gained compression attributes; partition list information is supported

entries.text: 修复 Oracle 多用户与 schema 不一致时找不到表、SQL Server 用 use db 切换数据库等问题
entries.textEn: Fixed missing tables when the Oracle user and schema differ, and SQL Server switching databases with use db

entries.text: 新增 MySQL 的 replace 语句支持；统计信息采集改用 execQuery
entries.textEn: Added MySQL replace statement support; statistics collection uses execQuery

entries.text: 在线获取 Oracle 表的行数、默认值与注释
entries.textEn: Retrieve Oracle table row counts, defaults and comments online

entries.text: 缺少数据库对象时不再给出严重警告
entries.textEn: A missing database object no longer raises a severe warning

entries.text: 按传入的规则列表过滤语法类等无独立规则类的审核规则
entries.textEn: Syntax-level audit rules without a dedicated rule class are filtered by the supplied rule list

entries.text: 「避免不必要的更新操作」改为非重写规则
entries.textEn: The unnecessary-update rule is no longer a rewrite rule

entries.text: 新增 RuleCalculationOnDistributedColumns
entries.textEn: Added RuleCalculationOnDistributedColumns

entries.text: 新增或修改约 60 个优化算法以支持 CCDDC 开发
entries.textEn: Added or reworked around 60 optimisation algorithms for CCDDC development

entries.text: 谓词分析增加 null/between/inValues 的过滤率估计
entries.textEn: Predicate analysis estimates filter rates for null/between/inValues

entries.text: 其余内部改动（4 条提交）
